image_notes: Mosaic of TRC scans thro_4785-6top.jpg (top/west half, placed at x+200,y+0) and thro_4783-4bottom.jpg (bottom/east half, placed at x+0,y+1555). Seam offset estimated by eye from fence/pen/barn continuity, uncertainty ~+/-20 px (~4 ft). Source map: 'Archeological site and post locations by Paul Beaubien (Sept 1957), site survey by Ken Kerr(?) Sept 1957, additions Taylor 1959'; nominal scale 1 in = 30 ft.
scale_check: House outline 297x153 px vs 60x30 ft; blacksmith 165x77 px vs 33x16 ft (Taylor); dugout 70 px vs 14 ft (Beaubien); corral ~296 px vs 62 ft -> ~5.0 px/ft
orientation: Map +x points roughly north, +y roughly east (river at bottom). Partial ORIENT arrow (cut off at right edge of scan) suggests north = +x rotated ~16 deg toward +y (i.e. image +x is ~N16W); treat as +/-5 deg at best. Taylor: Beaubien baseline 'did not run in a north-south direction'.
